description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Gdpr' within the Opencart framework, responsible for handling GDPR-related email notifications and actions such as user requests and account deletion. It includes methods for generating GDPR request emails and processing account removal notifications.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class handling GDPR request and removal email notifications in the Opencart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GDPR request emails, generating and sending the notification to the user with a personalized link.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles GDPR account removal notifications, sending confirmation email to the user after account deletion.
